svg.title: Uttarakhand Riders — project card
svg.desc: A 3D superbike race through the hills: from Ramnagar past Corbett and the Kosi river up to Ranikhet. Three riders, phone controls and voice chat. Built with Three.Js, Node.Js, Pwa. Live demo. Banner: the game's real title screen.
